summary: This spec describes "Learn mode", a layout that replaces a camera walk through a canvas's sections. It sets out a guide text on the left, tabbed views on the right, one shared composer, and how entering and leaving work.

options.label: When Learn mode starts and ends
options.what: You will see that Learn mode is on exactly while a walk runs, how it is entered and left, and what is hidden and restored.

options.label: Top row and guide split
options.what: You will understand the top row with the walk pill and Learn|Canvas toggle, plus the left guide showing the section heading, lead and follow text.

options.label: Cards, Canvas, TOC and Chat tabs
options.what: You will learn what each right-hand tab shows, including how a card is scaled to fit and why notebooks are a special case.

options.label: One composer and no Focus
options.what: You will see why Focus entry points are removed and how a single composer serves every tab and routes answers to Chat.

options.label: What is kept, and the tests
options.what: You will see which walk behaviours remain, which are dropped, and which tests cover enter/leave, tabs and the green bar.

cannot.why: It is a spec that names components and tests but contains no code.

cannot.thing: Why the earlier camera walk was designed as it was
cannot.why: It only says the card was too small to read.
